title: Bundle Current Pointer (v1)
description: Schema for bundles/<bundle_id>/current.json. A small, atomically-rewritten pointer file naming which immutable revision is presently live, plus the previous revision for rollback. Publishing a new revision is staged then atomically swapped; rollback is just re-pointing current to previous_revision — it never deletes or edits revision directories.

previous_revision.description: The immediately prior current_revision, retained for rollback. Null only for a bundle's first-ever publish.
